verses.text: Yahweh spoke to Moses: 📜
“Tell Israel: If anyone accidentally breaks one of Yahweh’s commands—doing something he said not to do—here’s what happens. ⚠️
“If the anointed priest sins and brings guilt on the people, he must bring Yahweh a flawless young bull as a sin offering for that sin. 🐂
“Bring the bull to the Meeting Tent entrance, before Yahweh. Put your hand on its head and slaughter it there before Yahweh. 🩸
“The anointed priest must take some of the bull’s blood into the Meeting Tent. 🩸
“Dip a finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times before Yahweh, in front of the sanctuary curtain. 7️⃣
“Put some blood on the horns of the fragrant-incense altar before Yahweh inside the Meeting Tent. Pour the rest at the base of the burnt-offering altar by the entrance. 🩸
“Take all the bull’s fat for the sin offering—the fat covering the inner parts and all the fat attached to them, 🐂
“both kidneys with the fat near the loins, and the liver’s covering, removed along with the kidneys. 🐂
“Take them just as you do from a peace-offering bull, and have the priest burn them on the burnt-offering altar. 🔥
“Take the bull’s hide, all its meat, head, legs, inner parts, and dung— 🐂
“the whole bull, basically. Carry it outside the camp to a clean place where the ashes are dumped, then burn it on a wood fire there. 🔥
“If the whole Israelite community sins without realizing it—breaking a command Yahweh gave and becoming guilty—⚠️
“when that sin comes to light, the community must bring a young bull as a sin offering to the Meeting Tent. 🐂
“The community’s elders must put their hands on the bull’s head before Yahweh, and the bull must be slaughtered there before Yahweh. 🩸
“The anointed priest must take some of the bull’s blood into the Meeting Tent. 🩸
“Dip a finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times before Yahweh, in front of the curtain. 7️⃣
“Put some blood on the horns of the altar inside the Meeting Tent, before Yahweh. Pour all the remaining blood at the base of the burnt-offering altar by the entrance. 🩸
“Remove all the bull’s fat and burn it on the altar. 🔥
“Handle this bull just like the sin-offering bull. The priest will make atonement for the community, and they’ll be forgiven. 🕊️
“Carry the bull outside the camp and burn it just like the first one. This is the community’s sin offering. 🔥
“If a leader accidentally breaks one of Yahweh’s commands and becomes guilty, ⚠️
“when that sin is pointed out to him, he must bring a flawless male goat as his offering. 🐐
“He must put his hand on the goat’s head and slaughter it where the burnt offerings are slaughtered before Yahweh. It’s a sin offering. 🩸
“The priest must take some blood from the sin offering with a finger and put it on the burnt-offering altar’s horns. Pour the rest at the altar’s base. 🩸
“Burn all its fat on the altar, like the fat from a peace offering. The priest will make atonement for the leader’s sin, and he’ll be forgiven. 🕊️
“If anyone among the people accidentally breaks one of Yahweh’s commands and becomes guilty, ⚠️
“when that sin is pointed out, the person must bring a flawless female goat as an offering for the sin. 🐐
“Put a hand on the sin offering’s head and slaughter it where the burnt offering is slaughtered. 🩸
“The priest must take some of its blood with a finger and put it on the burnt-offering altar’s horns. Pour the rest at the altar’s base. 🩸
“Remove all its fat, just as you remove the fat from a peace offering. The priest will burn it on the altar as an aroma pleasing to Yahweh, make atonement for the person, and they’ll be forgiven. 🔥
“If the person brings a lamb as a sin offering, it must be a flawless female. 🐑
“Put a hand on its head and slaughter it as a sin offering, where the burnt offering is slaughtered. 🩸
“The priest must take some blood from the sin offering with a finger and put it on the burnt-offering altar’s horns. Pour all the rest at the altar’s base. 🩸

“Remove all its fat as you do with the lamb from a peace offering. The priest will burn it on the altar with Yahweh’s fire offerings. He’ll make atonement for the person’s sin, and they’ll be forgiven. 🕊️
